hud.heading: heading
status.needWalrus: select a Walrus to deploy a pod
status.noPod: no pod aboard - go back to the carrier
status.tooFar: {metres} m from the nearest command node
help.helm: W/S throttle - A/D rudder - arrows climb/dive when flying - X all stop - G graphics tier
help.units: 1 launch Manta - 2 launch Walrus - N next unit - click sea to send it
help.orders: T take the controls - R recall - P deploy ACCB pod - B virus bomb - E flares
status.noOwnedIsland: you hold no island to make a depot of
help.supply: L supply run - K make the nearest island your depot
status.noAmmo: no rounds left aboard that unit
damage.title: DAMAGE CONTROL
damage.legend: click a section to change repair priority - Z closes
status.overheated: the mount is too hot to fire
help.targeting: click an enemy to attack it - with nothing selected, the ship laser takes it
island.title: {name} · #{id}
island.locked: the role is settled once anything is built
help.island: click an island you hold to plan it
status.speedVote: speed proposed - the clock moves when everybody agrees
status.noVirus: no virus bomb aboard that Walrus
status.noCentre: no enemy command centre here to subvert
start.title: CARRIER DOMINION
start.endIslands: one side holds two thirds of the islands
start.endTime: the clock runs out, ahead on points
start.note: click a line to change it - ENTER to sail
help.scope: [ ] scope range - M sound - C camera: chase / gunsight / map - H or ? this list
lobby.title: WAR ROOM - JOIN CODE {code}
lobby.hostNote: you set the war - it starts when everybody is ready
lobby.guestNote: the host sets the war - say when you are ready
status.flaresReloading: the flare launchers are still reloading
warover.length: the war ran {hours} h {minutes} min of its own time
tip.stop: All stop: throttle to zero on whatever you are steering.
tip.flares: Fire decoy flares: breaks the lock of every heat-seeker near the ship. Costs ordnance; the launchers reload.
tip.supply: Toggle the supply run: the lighter cycles between your stockpile island and the ship, hauling fuel, ordnance, materials and parts.
tip.depot: Make the nearest island you own the stockpile: the cargo network ships everything there, and the lighter loads from it.
tip.damage: The damage control board: click a section to set its repair priority. The yard repairs in that order, spending materials.
tip.camera: Cycle the camera: chase, gunsight (first person from the mount), strategic map.
tip.manta: Launch a Manta from the hangar. It defends itself; give it a target by clicking an enemy.
tip.walrus: Launch a Walrus. Send it ashore by clicking a point; it carries the pod and the virus bomb.
tip.next: Select the next unit that is out.
tip.controls: Take the controls of the selected unit (press again to hand back). Arrows climb and dive a Manta.
tip.recall: Recall the selected unit to the carrier for fuel, rounds and payloads.
tip.fire: Fire the selected weapon: down the nose when flying, at what is in range when not.
tip.pod: Deploy the ACCB pod at a command node within 60 m: takes the island bare. Costs 80 materials to replace.
tip.virus: Deploy the virus bomb at an enemy command node: takes the island INTACT, works and guns included. Costs 120 ordnance.
tip.debug: The diagnostic strip: tick, hash, fps, stores.
tip.stores: The quartermaster: what every island you hold has in stock, which one is the depot (click a row to change it), and the production bias steering your factories.
tip.escort: Order the selected unit to escort: it takes station on the carrier and fights whatever comes, returning by itself when fuel runs low.
status.course: course laid in - the autopilot has the wheel
stores.title: QUARTERMASTER
stores.note: click an island row to make it the depot - the network ships everything there
status.noReplay: no saved war to replay - data/autosave.json is empty
status.replayDone: end of record - the war stood here when it was saved
touch.rotate: turn the device sideways - the bridge needs the width
tip.climb: hold to climb - the flown Manta noses up while held
tip.dive: hold to dive - the flown Manta noses down while held
tip.cameraTabs: the three ways to look at the war - click one, or cycle with C
log.title: SIGNALS
tip.log: the last sixteen reports from the ship’s computers
log.grounded: aground - engines answer, the hull pays
log.fuelEmpty: bunkers dry - the ship is adrift
log.hullReplaced: a replacement {kind} came off the line
status.surrenderArm: strike your colours? ESC again within 3 seconds confirms
status.surrendered: colours struck - the ship is scuttled
help.extras: 5-8 select a hull directly - O rear view - I signals log - ESC ESC surrender
status.telemetryWeak: telemetry fading - the carrier is losing your picture, turn back
tip.pause: pause - in a LAN war the table votes
tip.auto: the autopilot has the wheel - click to clear the course
tip.unitChip: name this hull - PILOT, RECALL and orders act on the named one
log.nodeDestroyed: the command centre on {island} was destroyed - the island is nobody's
